title: The Truth Mara Exposes
logline: After publicly exposing the powerful lover who betrayed her, Mara discovers his identity may be fabricated and risks a call that reveals she may have exposed the wrong man.
target_audience: Female viewers ages 18-34 who enjoy dark romance, betrayal, revenge, hidden identities, and serialized conspiracy thrillers.
hook: Mara hijacks Adrian's gala livestream: "He used my love to hide his crimes—and tonight, everyone sees the proof."
synopsis: Mara hijacks her former lover Adrian's gala livestream and publishes proof that he used her name to hide secret payments. Her upload unlocks a file showing she was targeted before their romance and that Adrian's identity was recently created. Mara calls the file's hidden contact, only to see an identical man claiming she exposed the wrong brother.
episode_goal: Have Mara publicly expose Adrian, investigate the evidence her exposure unlocks, and make a risky choice that reveals his identity may be false.
